name: cauldron
line: a web framework from zero dependencies
question: How much of a modern web stack can one Lisp binary carry with no dependencies at all?
body: A whole web framework from zero dependencies in Common Lisp — HTTP server, Postgres wire protocol, crypto, a LiveView-style UI engine, an admin panel, and an agent system — shipped as one SBCL binary. No Quicklisp, no FFI, no C.
alt: cauldron — one sealed binary holding a whole web stack, nothing crossing in from outside
